title: AI UGC Video Ad Pricing | AIVideosUGC
description: AI UGC video ad pricing: Starter is $24.50 a month for 200 credits, Pro is $35 for 300, and Premium is $63 for 600. See the cost before each job.
h1: Plans for Scroll-Stopping AI UGC Video Ads
lead: Turn a product idea into a scroll-stopping UGC video ad. No creator to book, no editing skill to learn, and no hassle before the first file.
card: Starter, Pro, and Premium each give you a monthly credit balance for photos and videos.
intro: Starter gives you 200 credits for $24.50 per month. Pro gives you 300 for $35, and Premium gives you 600 for $63. Use the same balance for listing photos and video ads. The charge for each job shows before you confirm.
credits_explained: One product photo uses 24 credits. A 6-second video uses 24, a 10-second video uses 40, a 15-second video uses 60, and a 30-second video uses 120. You can add up to 7 reference photos. The amount appears before you confirm the job.
A job reserves its credits while it runs and charges them when the file is ready. When a job fails, the reserved credits return to your balance on their own. You do not send a ticket for that return.

Pro is $35 a month for 300 credits. That covers about 12 product photos or 5 fifteen-second videos, with all 53 AI actors and no watermark. Starter is $24.50 for 200 credits, about 8 photos or 3 of those videos. Premium is $63 for 600 credits, about 25 photos or 10 of those videos.
teams: Making more than Premium covers, for a shop or an agency? Email support@aivideosugc.com with how many photos and videos you make in a month. We will suggest a setup that fits that volume.

faq.q: How do I move to a larger plan when I need more credits?
faq.a: Move to Pro or Premium in your account when you need more monthly credits. Email support@aivideosugc.com if you need help.

faq.q: Can an AI actor hold or wear the product I sell?
faq.a: Yes. An AI actor can hold, wear, or show the product in your photo. You can make a demonstration without booking a model.

faq.q: How do I cancel and keep the month I already paid?
faq.a: Email support@aivideosugc.com to cancel your plan. Your paid period stays active until it ends.

faq.q: Can I make another version with a new actor or a new opening?
faq.a: Yes. Change the actor, opening, or voice to make another version. Each video uses its own credits based on length.

faq.q: Does the file I download carry a watermark?
faq.a: No. Downloaded photos and videos have no watermark. Use them in your store, social posts, and paid ads.

faq.q: How do I make my first video from a photo or a product link?
faq.a: Upload a product photo or paste a link, choose an AI actor, and make your video. You can download it in minutes.

faq.q: How long do I wait before the video is ready to post?
faq.a: A video is usually ready in a few minutes. If a job fails, its credits return to your account.

faq.q: Can I run the download in paid ads, on my store, and in client work?
faq.a: Yes. Use the watermark-free download in paid ads, on your store, or for client work. Follow each platform’s current rules.

cta_title: Pick a Plan and Make the Next Ad
cta_lead: Check the credit cost of the next photo or video, then start on the monthly plan that fits the work.
